G1.evidence: No method exceeds 50 lines; the longest are OrderService.create (about 40 lines) and CouponService.create (about 38 lines).

G2.evidence: src/main/java/com/example/order/orders/OrderService.java create(): the 'look up, throw COUPON_NOT_FOUND / PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND if missing' logic and message are copied from CouponService.get and ProductService.get.

G3.evidence: Error codes are in the ErrorCode enum, statuses in OrderStatus/CouponType, and headers and idempotency states are constants (OrderController.USER_HEADER, IdempotencyService.IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED). Remaining literals are local, single-use values.

G4.evidence: Methods and fields have intent-revealing names (expireIfOverdue, releaseReservation, lockProducts, etc.). One-letter names appear only as lambda parameters (o, p, e).

G5.evidence: No commented-out code. All ErrorCode values, getters, and imports are used; no unused classes or methods.

G6.evidence: No empty catch blocks. OrderExpirationJob logs with log.warn, GlobalExceptionHandler.handleOther logs with log.error, and PaymentGatewayClient.send wraps exceptions with their cause. Note: OrderQueryService.Cursor.decode catches RuntimeException broadly and drops the cause, but it deliberately converts bad input into a 400.

G7.evidence: Order.addItem uses Math.addExact/multiplyExact and Coupon.discountFor uses Math.multiplyExact. Amounts are long (no double), and ProductService/OrderService.validateCreate check ranges in advance.

G8.evidence: Instant.now() is called directly in CouponService.create, ProductService.create, OrderExpirationJob.expireOverdueOrders, and OrderService.now(); no Clock is injected.

G9.evidence: src/main/java/com/example/order/orders/Order.java: transition(from, to) and the markPaid/markShipped/... methods hold the transition rules in one place, and state is only changed through these methods (OrderService repeats the check first only to build the error response).

G10.evidence: src/main/java/com/example/order/payment/PaymentGatewayClient.java: HttpClient.connectTimeout(timeout), HttpRequest.timeout(timeout), and future.get(timeout) are all set.

G11.evidence: OrderQueryService.list appends only fixed JPQL fragments and passes values through setParameter. IdempotencyService uses ? binding and the repository uses :param binding.

G12.evidence: Every class is under 400 lines. Products, coupons, orders, payment, and idempotency each have their own service/client; OrderService coordinates the order flow (about 300 lines).

G13.evidence: No TODO/FIXME. Comments in OrderService (lock order, R5 rollback), IdempotencyService (only 2xx stored), and Coupon.discountFor (R2.4) match the actual behavior.

G14.evidence: Order, Product, Coupon, and OrderItem have no public setters; values change only through intent-revealing methods such as markPaid, reserve, confirmSale, use/restore, and applyCoupon.
